name: duet-chatgpt
description: Run Duet review and implementation loops with two native ChatGPT Work peers, using only ChatGPT's internal models.

interface.longDescription: Coordinate a reviewer and coder inside ChatGPT Work. Alternate native peer turns, preserve their host handles, track findings and checks, and require consecutive rationale-backed agreement on the same revision. The bundled Python helper records state; it makes no model or network calls. Requires native subagents and Python file execution in the ChatGPT host.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Duet for ChatGPT. Spawn native reviewer and coder subagents. Use internal ChatGPT models only. Limit to six turns.
